# Statement-coverage floor for the module total.
#
# `make coverage-gate` (tfkit) fails a run below this percentage. This is the
# organisation's starting floor for a provider scaffolded from the kit: raise it
# as tests land. After changing it, run `make coverage-readme` so README.md
# states the same number; the `coverage-readme-in-test` check fails when the two
# disagree.
80
